newsitem.title: UK: Mexico cuts Dec Maya crude price to Europe/U.S..
newsitem.headline: Mexico cuts Dec Maya crude price to Europe/U.S..

text.p: Mexico cut December prices of its Maya crude to European and U.S. lifters by reducing its differentials by 20 cents and 15 cent respectively, an official at state-owned oil company PEMEX said.
PEMEX also kept the price for Isthmus crude unchanged for Europe but raised the price by 10 cents for the United States.
It also raised the price of Olmeca crude by five cents to U.S. customers.

Mexican crude is priced in differentials against the PEMEX formulae. The changes take Maya to a $1.60 discount to the formula from $1.40 below in November for Europe. Isthmus was unchanged at a 0.06 cent discount.

For the United States, Maya was down to -$1.75 in December from -$1.60 in November. Isthmus came up to a 90 cent discount against a $1.00 discount in November. Olmeca was raised 15 cents to 45 cents over from 30 cents in November.
Last week PEMEX lower the price formula for Maya to Asia by 20 cents per barrel but raised Isthmus by 15 cents, traders said.
